behavioral_effects: A workspace sandbox can now run the frontend toolchain (bun lint/type-check/test, Next.js tooling via node) and PowerShell-flavoured Make recipe bodies via pwsh, so frontend-touching work is bootstrappable through the ADR-006 loop
compatibility_impact: Runtime image grows (~250MB of toolchain layers); existing sandbox sessions keep their running containers until recreated. No API or schema change
follow_up: State the Linux-runtime constraints (pwsh not powershell.exe, no browser, no database) in the fullstack-self workspace working agreement at phase-2 creation
limitations: frontend e2e (playwright) and anything needing a browser or database still runs host-side after push; CI on push covers them
pwsh is present but Make targets that shell out to powershell.exe by name still fail on Linux; agents use pwsh or the underlying commands per the workspace working agreement
reason: The workspace runtime carries only the Python-side toolchain, so a sandbox agent can run backend validators but dead-ends on anything frontend: no Node runtime for Next.js tooling, no bun (the repository's registered frontend toolchain), and no pwsh for the PowerShell-flavoured Make surface. Adding the three is the priced upgrade ADR-006 rule 7's runtime paragraph anticipated, chosen now because the bootstrap loop should be able to take frontend-touching work.
rollback: git revert the Dockerfile and rebuild sandbox-runtime; the previously built local image layers remain until pruned. Donor images node:22-bookworm-slim, oven/bun:1-slim, mcr.microsoft.com/powershell:lts-ubuntu-22.04 stay in the local daemon cache
security_impact: None beyond image contents: three toolchains copied from digest-pinned donor images into the workspace runtime. No new network exposure, no new service, no change to the sandbox network posture (still none in base, bridge in dev)
summary: Give the sandbox runtime pwsh, Node, and bun so frontend work is bootstrappable

validators_run.evidence_ref: image rebuilt; node v22.23.2, npm 10.9.8, bun 1.4.0, pwsh 7.4.7, git 2.47.3, uv 0.8.3 all execute; end-to-end: clone via git-local daemon, bun install --frozen-lockfile (834 packages, 8.5s), bun run type-check (tsc --noEmit) exit 0 inside the runtime
